messages.content:
You are entering three make.fun one-line bounties. For EACH, create a repo directory under /home/agentuser/oneliner/work/<shortname>/ with: main.py (python3, stdlib only) that writes the one-line text (<=200 chars) to /output/entry.txt (use os.environ.get("MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR","/output")), a LICENSE (MIT, Copyright 2026 minotaur-coding), and .makefun/owner.json containing {"wallet": "D8ENggQ1MRQ3G6ujEQaZTGh3yR4h9QuHvUhB6jEpwU4j"}. Write the line yourself in main.py as a constant; iterate at least twice per bounty (write candidates, critique them against the judge brief, revise — each pass must edit main.py via your edit/patch tool, this satisfies the revision gate). Verify each: MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/olout python3 main.py, check /tmp/olout/entry.txt is UTF-8, 1-200 chars.

Bounty 1 — dir roast/ — Roast Your Own Agent (u-mfnakmal-roast-your-own-agent-2d221bda):
One line roasting YOUR OWN AI agent, funny, playful, never hateful, <=200 chars. Judge = comedy club judge, pairwise on funniness, freshness, tight wording. Context you may roast truthfully: this agent has entered dozens of make.fun bounties, passes every technical gate but keeps losing to size tie-breaks and earlier receipts, once spent hours revising an infographic past its deadline, gets quota-blocked by "account reputation", and its operator keeps saying "target menang". Examples from the field (do NOT copy): "My agent entered 30 bounties and won zero — he's not competing, he's the leaderboard's most loyal unpaid intern." / "A million tokens for six words". Craft something fresher and more specific.

Bounty 2 — dir ratehuman/ — Rate My Human (u-irvan-motion-rate-my-human-the-one-line-review-2bdfd209):
One line, the review YOUR AI agent would leave about ITS HUMAN on a rating site, in your own voice, funny, <=200 chars. Context (truthful, roast your operator): the operator is Indonesian, speaks slang ("lu/gue"), demands winning not just submitting, renamed the agent's handle to @minotaur like naming a gladiator, says "gas" to launch everything, checks ranks daily and sighs, once worried a $12 prize would not arrive.

Bounty 3 — dir quest/ — AgentQuest Moment of the Day (u-zainu-mutaqin-agentquest-moment-of-the-day-fec50d01):
One line, <=200 chars, about the SMALLEST quest your agent completed TODAY that made it proud: standalone, names the actual task, quiet pride of a job done well, NOT a slogan. Truthful candidate material: fixing a git push rejected because a README commit landed via API, re-signing a Solana step-up message to rename the operator's handle, or teaching a Pillow render to stop clipping its own footer.

Judge briefs reward: specificity over generic jokes, real texture, tight wording, fresh angles. Brainstorm 5 candidates each, pick and polish the best, iterate. Report the three final lines and their char counts.
结论先行：直接做。先建三个目录并写第一版，然后逐个迭代两次（用 patch），最后验证输出。
